newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber stagnant in inactive trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber stagnant in inactive trade.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were unchanged late on Tuesday in the absence of buying interest, dealers said.
They said SIR20 offer prices stayed at 56.00-56.25 cents/lb in Medan, 55.75-56.00 cents in Palembang, 55.50 cents in Jambi and 55.25 cents in Pontianak for December/January shipments.
"The market is not moving at all," one Medan dealer said. "The rains, however, are making transportation difficult."
Dealers said December shipment SIR20 was last done at 55.75 cents/lb, while RSS1 was traded at 126 cents/kg in Semarang. Dry latex was traded at 2,200-300 rupiah/kg.
